# Gemini Notebook adds a free textbook catalog beside purchased ebooks


By OpenTools Team


Students can browse hundreds of included textbooks; purchased‑book access remains a separate path.


##


Browse the catalog


Google’s[October 29 announcement](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-notebook/new-access-textbooks/) says hundreds of textbooks are available at no charge. In a notebook, Add sources → Textbooks opens the catalog. Named providers include OpenStax, Open Textbook Library and S Chand Publishing.


##


Purchased books differ


The[earlier program](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-notebook/expert-intelligence-leading-sources/) covered select ebooks bought through Google Play Books, with collaborators needing their own copy. The catalog expansion does not make every purchased book free.


Original access map: the new textbook catalog is free; the earlier selected‑ebook program required purchases, including each collaborator’s own copy.
